name: Ordinary all-pixel PCA with orthogonal display rotation
input_preprocessing: Original L2-normalization of the frozen 8D pixel embeddings
pca_fit: Unweighted centered covariance of all 65,536 pixels from the four selected external views
retained_components: First three principal components; explained variance order retained separately
allowed_display_change: Orthogonal rotation, including component sign and order choices, inside the same top-three-PC subspace
rotation_selection: Learned group centroids and original query points score display separability; they never weight PCA or modify pixel colors
rgb_mapping: One global per-channel linear min/max mapping over all pixels and all examples, followed by 8-bit quantization
